# EditGalaxy

EditGalaxy is a creator resource website focused on CapCut templates and AI image prompts.

## Main sections
- CapCut Templates: searchable template cards with CapCut links, usage instructions, descriptions, metadata and live usage-based trending.
- AI Image Prompts: searchable prompt cards with copyable girl/boy prompt versions, usage instructions, descriptions and live copy-based trending.
